baseline.label: V5 · Current baseline
baseline.note: Sticky track and boundary clamping without layout hints. Smooth on desktop; touch settling still steps on iOS.

native.label: V7 · Native-flow control
native.note: Fixed-width cards in normal flow. Smoother on iOS; desktop scroll-wheel settling still steps.

rounded.label: V8 · Whole-pixel settling
rounded.note: Rounds positions to whole pixels during custom settling. Smooth mouse release on desktop.

touch-handoff.label: V9 · Custom touch settling
touch-handoff.note: Native dragging followed by fractional custom settling at release. Smoother initial motion, but triggers late corrections and boundary overscroll.

original.label: V1 · Original native scrolling
original.note: Native smooth scrolling with queued geometry updates. Stutters on desktop and iOS.

first-token.label: V2 · MD3-timed settling
first-token.note: MD3-timed settling with native scroll writes each frame. Still rough while settling.

handoff.label: V3 · Synchronized visual settling
handoff.note: Fractional settling and artwork offsets; syncs native scroll on completion. Smoother on desktop; touch still jitters and stutters.

isolation.label: V4 · Boundary clamping
isolation.note: Boundary clamping with layout containment and compositor hints. Less directional jitter; settling still stutters.

diagnostic.label: V6 · Fixed masks
diagnostic.note: Fixed mask widths and artwork offsets driven by scroll position. Stutters, with visible gaps and overlaps.
